values.note: Trainer Level is exposed because Rocket scaling may depend on it. Level 50 is a demo default only.

values.label: Pokemon GO battle turn length
values.note: Used for Trainer Battle move duration displays from PvPoke turn counts.

values.label: Rocket pause after player Charged Attack
values.note: Experimental simulator default. Modeled as a 3-turn Rocket stun lock after player Charged Attacks; duration is not yet verified and must remain visible as an assumption.

values.label: Rocket pause after player switch
values.note: Experimental simulator default. Modeled as a 1.5-turn Rocket pause after the player switches Pokemon.

values.label: Charged Attack wall-clock overhead
values.note: Approximate real animation duration from tap through damage and normal play resuming. This is not used as the battle-turn timeline scale.

values.label: Charged Attack battle-turn registration
values.note: Experimental simulator default. Charged Attacks register as a 0.5-turn span on the battle-turn timeline, while real animation takes longer.

values.label: Rocket opponent Charged Attack interval
values.note: Experimental simulator default. Opponent Charged Attack timing is a placeholder cadence until Rocket move energy and move selection are implemented.

values.label: Rocket opponent Charged Attack damage
values.note: Experimental simulator default. Damage after player shields are exhausted is a placeholder until Rocket charged moves and scaling are implemented.

values.label: Player shields
values.note: Experimental simulator default. Modeled naively as shielding the first two opponent Charged Attacks.

values.label: Rocket Grunt shields
values.note: Experimental simulator default. Grunt shield behavior is treated as configurable until validated.

values.label: Rocket Leader shields
values.note: Experimental simulator default. Leaders are modeled as shielding the first available player Charged Attacks.

values.label: Giovanni shields
values.note: Experimental simulator default. Giovanni is modeled as shielding the first available player Charged Attacks.
